issues.on_page: South Sioux City Community Foundation: Total other financing sources (uses) 228,434

This is inconsistent with the other nonmajor funds. Library, Fire and Police Pension budget-basis 'Taxes' lines were typed as property tax from the GAAP statements even though they don't tie either. Here the GAAP General Fund prints Property Taxes 2,934,783 (p5) as its only property-type tax, but the line was left unlabeled. One approach needs to be applied to all of them.

The GAAP General Fund column (p5) prints only Franchise Taxes 1,142,261 and Occupation Taxes 29,529 besides property tax, and both are occupation/franchise tax. Street Projects 'Other Taxes' was typed by the same single-tax-type reasoning (sales tax), but this line was left in other taxes. The amount doesn't tie exactly because it is budgetary basis.

issues.on_page: Library Taxes 613,051 (budgetary basis); combining statement p11 Taxes 606,285
issues.issue: The tax type comes from the combining statement's Taxes row, not from a printed label, and the budget-basis amount doesn't tie to it. The evidence standard says budget-basis lines that don't tie stay unlabeled, and derived classifications should carry 'computed'. Only category_evidence is set here.

issues.on_page: Fire Taxes 282,142 (budgetary basis); combining statement p12 Taxes 280,969
issues.issue: Same as the Library line. The type comes from the combining statement, the budget-basis amount doesn't tie, and there is no 'computed' marker.

issues.on_page: Police Pension Taxes 210,607 (budgetary basis); combining statement p13 Taxes 207,985
issues.issue: Same as the Library line. The type comes from the combining statement, the budget-basis amount doesn't tie, and there is no 'computed' marker.

issues.on_page: Street Projects Other Taxes 1,956,252 (budgetary basis); combining statement p15 Local Option Sales Taxes 1,979,127
issues.issue: Sales tax is inferred because sales tax is the only tax row in the GAAP column. The budget-basis amount doesn't tie, and there is no 'computed' marker (category_evidence only).
